value.value: Deprotonation yields CdS, PhNCS, displaced PTC and BH+; protonation of PTC gives aniline/CS2 and regenerates base; aniline adds to PhNCS to thiourea. Base could be adventitious, precursor itself and/or generated aniline. This is a proposal consistent with observations.
